meta.name: add-dial
meta.description: Add Dial channel integration — a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给应用接入真实号码,支持短信与AI语音通话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发需要电话或短信能力的应用
copy.tagline_en: Add a real phone number for SMS and AI voice calls to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs phone or SMS capabilities

howto.what: 装上后,你的助手会通过 Dial 平台获得一个真实手机号,可以收发短信、接打 AI 语音电话。来电会用设定好的问候语应答,短信按你选的权限决定谁能联系。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Dial、给助手配一个能收发短信和接打电话的号码时触发;随后按流程引导你登录、选择谁能发短信、并配对手机。

say.text: 给我接入 Dial,加一个能收发短信和打电话的号码
say.note: 开始安装 Dial 适配器并引导登录配对。

say.text: 把 Dial 电话渠道加上,短信和 AI 语音通话都要
say.note: 会复制适配器、装 CLI,再走签入流程。

say.text: 帮我设置 Dial 号码的接听问候语
say.note: 把来电应答提示写到这条线路上。

howto.what_en: After install, your assistant gets a real phone number on Dial and can send/receive SMS and make/take AI voice calls. Incoming calls use the configured greeting; texting access follows the policy you choose.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Dial or give the assistant a real phone number for SMS and voice calls; then walks you through sign-in, access choice, and phone pairing.

say_en.text: Add Dial and give me a number for SMS and calls.
say_en.note: Starts installing the Dial adapter and guides sign-in.

say_en.text: Set up the Dial channel with SMS and AI voice calls.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the CLI, then walks through sign-in.

say_en.text: Set the Dial number's inbound greeting for me.
say_en.note: Writes the call-answer prompt to the line.
